title: Fold it
description:
A variadic template takes any number of arguments. A **fold expression** applies one operator across all of them.

Write:

- `sum(...)`: adds all its arguments, `(args + ...)`. Called with no arguments it returns 0 (use the form with a starting value: `(args + ... + 0)`).
- `allTrue(...)`: `true` when every argument is true; with no arguments, `true`.
- `count(...)`: how many arguments were passed (`sizeof...(args)`).
hints: Each function is `template <typename... Ts>` with parameters `Ts... args`. The folds are `(args + ... + 0)` and `(args && ... && true)`.
`sizeof...(args)` counts the arguments; it is a number known at compile time.
